historical_native_task_reports.limitation: Report history is visible; current scheduler enablement and independent native experiment execution were not queried/verified.

native_consumed_v2.required: Next native report cites this directory and a resolved commit.

native_registered_then_executed_new_expe.required: Plan time/hash, actual execution command/status and complete output hash; not a digest of an existing study.

native_persisted_results.historical_blocker: Prior reports described platform pre-execution write denials. No workaround or restoration claim.
native_persisted_results.required: Native run publishes permitted paths and verifies exact readback, or reports persistence_blocked.

subsequent_native_run_restored_memory.required: A later native run reads the previous run state and continues its pending work.
